Adding files to the other fixtures would change their file lists and context (the reacquisition fixture allows only one file) without testing anything new.

- `git diff` shows only the two role lines and two comment lines.

I did not run the three cases: their fixtures create temporary worksites, and the canonical `build/` predates the intake check. I ran no build, wrote no generated output and made no writes outside the grant.
